goal: Add test coverage to detect an upstream toolchain bug where file copy overwrites fail on Windows
Helps catch toolchain defects that affect wallet migration backups
agreement: Mild support noting that adding the test seems harmless (maflcko)
Questioned the usefulness of testing for a compiler bug given negligible real-world impact (fanquake)
Suggests alternatives like rejecting affected compilers or avoiding the copy option (theuni, maflcko)

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because it adds coverage for a compiler defect that can cause wallet migration backups to fail
The benefit is limited because real-world impact is practically nonexistent and users rarely hit it
